scope: Indo-Aryan attested language clades including Romani/Domari; excludes Nuristani, Lomavren mixed language, proto-entry language Indo-Aryan, redirects and generic loan-source nodes. Each citation key gets an attribution, so rows across sources are not additive.
priority: First: 100–2000-record sources below 50% linked, ordered by source size, then language coverage. Smaller citation fragments remain visible but are not mistaken for full lexical sources. Candidates require lexical and source ownership verification.
